preconditions.expression: root1 is not None and root2 is not None
preconditions.description: Both input trees must be non-null and have the same number of nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in [root1, root2])
preconditions.description: All node values in both trees must be integers between 1 and 10^9 (inclusive).
Both trees must have the same number of levels (height + 1).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(sorted(level1) == sorted(level2) for level1, level2 in zip(get_levels(root1), get_levels(root2))) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if every corresponding level in the two trees is an anagram (i.e., contains the same values with the same frequencies), otherwise returns 0.

invariants.description: Helper function to extract node values level-wise from a binary tree, returning a list of lists where each sublist represents a level.
